TP_G0_factorization_failure.interpretation: The factorized zero-portal benchmark is not an RG-invariant surface. Positive portals are generated immediately above the parent threshold.

one_loop_abelian_landau_estimates.warning: Formal one-loop estimates far above the Planck scale have no physical EFT significance; they only show that g=0.30 is not the first perturbative obstruction.

one_loop_gauge_betas.derivation: For each U(1), one complex q=1 scalar and one complex q=3 scalar give b=(1^2+3^2)/3=10/3.

one_loop_kinetic_mixing_sources.reason: No active field carries both charges in any pair; charge conjugations provide all-orders protection on this slice.
